how_to_apply: Download the application form and instructions from the official website of the District Collector's Office, Jangaon District. The form is available until 5.00 PM on the last date.
Fill in the form and paste one photograph on it.
Enclose self attested copies of the certificates listed below.
Submit the application in person or through registered post to the Inward Section, Ground Floor, Collectorate, Jangaon.
Applications received after the due dates will be summarily rejected.
SSC or equivalent examination certificate with Bonafide Certificate
Intermediate or 10+2 examination certificate with Bonafide Certificate
Qualifying Examination Pass Certificate with Bonafide Certificate
Marks memos of all the years of the qualifying examination
Registration certificates issued by the respective Councils and Boards
Latest Caste Certificate issued by the Tahsildar / MRO concerned
Study certificates from 4th Class to 10th Class, or for private study, a residency certificate from the Tahsildar / MRO concerned

content_sections.heading: About the Jangaon District Recruitment
content_sections.text: The notification comes from the Office of the District Collector and District Magistrate, Jangaon District, in Telangana. The posts serve the Sakhi One Stop Centre under Mission Shakti, and the District Child Protection Unit (DCPU) and Child Help Line 1098 under Mission Vastalya. The District Employment Officer (FAC), who is Member/Convenor, forwarded this revised notification for release by Lr.No. A1/OS/47/2026-27, dated 29 October 2026, after the District Collector, as Chairman of the District Outsourcing Committee, gave permission.

content_sections.text: For each category, a merit list will be prepared from the marks obtained in the written exam and/or interview. It will be displayed on the Jangaon District website.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Engagement is on outsourcing basis. After that, services will be as per the need and subject to satisfactory performance. The place of posting is Jangaon district.

faq.question: Q1. Which posts can I apply for without a high school pass?
faq.answer: Multi Purpose Staff/Cook, Security Guard/Night Guard and Driver (1098) ask only that you be literate. A high school pass is preferred for all three, and the Driver also needs a Heavy Driving Licence.

faq.question: Q2. Which nursing qualifications are named for the paramedical posts?
faq.answer: The notice names B.Sc. Nursing, GNM and MPHW (Female), or a recognised paramedical diploma, along with a background in the health sector.

faq.question: Q3. Can I send my application by post?
faq.answer: Yes, registered post is allowed. The District Selection Committee is not responsible for postal delays, so a late-arriving envelope will not be excused.

faq.question: Q4. Where do I hand in the application in person?
faq.answer: Take it to the Inward Section on the Ground Floor of the Collectorate, Jangaon.

faq.question: Q5. What can I take into the exam hall?
faq.answer: Only a valid identity proof, a black or blue ball point pen and an exam pad.

faq.question: Q6. Is the medical test compulsory?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice makes it mandatory for every candidate appearing for the exam.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: The engagement is on outsourcing basis, and continued service depends on need and satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q8. Which post has the highest age limit?
faq.answer: Centre Administrator, at 50 years. Every other post stops at 44 years.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the merit list be published?
faq.answer: It will be displayed on the Jangaon District website, with a separate list prepared for each category.

faq.question: Q10. I studied privately. Which document replaces the study certificates?
faq.answer: Enclose a residency certificate from the Tahsildar / MRO concerned.
